_comment: Tier-2 for febio::rigid_body#2. The shipped indentation template run with and without its <Contact> section: with it, the block surface under the punch follows and only a small fraction of the contact travel remains as interpenetration; without it, the surface does not move and the ENTIRE travel becomes interpenetration. Both reach normal termination with exit 0, the same completed-step count, and no ERROR or WARNING — the missing interface is never mentioned. The fixture filters block-top nodes to the punch FOOTPRINT; an earlier draft took the extreme over all top nodes, which measures the untouched rim and reported working contact as inactive. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'missing_contact=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
